acceptableChoiceChange: For every set, subtract source-only acceptable-first-choice probability from the policy's probability, using the already frozen uniform scientific-tie convention
interpretation: These are marginal probability changes, not joint probabilities of a paired random draw. No coupling of different policy ties is assumed and probabilities are never multiplied independently to invent losses or rescues
setCounts: Report counts of sets with a decrease/increase. Untied 1-to-0 or 0-to-1 changes may additionally be described as regressed/rescued cases
missingOutcomes: Any required unavailable probability leaves the comparison undefined; do not substitute zero
purpose: Clarify reporting vocabulary without changing the ranking, calibration or evaluation rules
